notes.title: West of the Witchlands 1.0.3 Release
notes.notes:
- Gun upgrade UI will now update when upgrading weapon
- Fixed an issue where two bosses would spawn in Act 3
- Fixed another faulty close button
- Bullets from friendly player should no longer damage you
- Fixed tile boundaries to prevent instances where they would overlap eachother  in level generation

notes.title: West of the Witchlands 1.0.2 Release
notes.notes:
Another hotfix patch!

Fixes:
- Bosses no longer will get stuck/stunlocked
- Fixed an issue where runes would disappear from a gun after upgrading
- Hub menu exit buttons now work properly
- Fixed an unconnected "Back" button in the UI
- Fixed values for "Sharpening" rune buff
- Fixed an issue where runes would cease functioning after upgrading the weapon they are attached to
- Removed a bugged camera in area 3

notes.title: West of the Witchlands 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Some post-1.0 hotfixes thanks to some very special testers : )
- Fixed bosses not showing
- Fixed Settings page missing in Brakktu's Tooth
- Potions will no longer get used while in inventory
- Back button in quit confirmation box working again

notes.title: West of the Witchlands 1.0!!!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm happy to announce that WotW has reached 1.0, and as such I am switching it over from early access to released! Thank you for the awesome feedback and interest so far in the early access stage. I'll continue to iterate and improve on this version, so look forward to some future patches, but for now thank you for playing!

Features:
- Act 3 is now fully functional, with a Final Boss and epilogues for each character

Adjustments:
- Boss gate VFX have been updated
- Icons have been updated for Gladiator & Sharpshooter

Fixes:
- Shadows in Javelina Flats have been fixed
- Fixed behavior where Javelina Flats boss freezes after a short delay
- Fixing cinema camera not kicking in for some instances

notes.title: Early Access v0.8
notes.notes:
Howdy everyone, it's been a minute. Life happened but now I'm back working on this, there are probably a few miscellaneous fixes that I've forgotten about since the last patch but here is everything that I can remember / have worked on recently:

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
===============
- Volumetric Fog has been removed for now. The performance cost was very high, and in many cases I felt it visually did not contribute very much.
- Scripting backend changed to IL2CPP. This should not change much for players but hopefully will help us squeeze a little more performance out of the engine.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
==================
Trench Gun:
Reload Time: 1.5s => 1.2s
Clip Size: 6 => 8
Fire Rage: 1s => 0.66s 

Bug Fixes
============
- Fixed shadows not appearing in several instances
- Priest abilities should work again
- Fixed several instance where runes could disappear
	- When placing a rune of the same type on a gun that already had one
	- When placing a rune on a gun in an upgrade table
	- When exiting out of a weapon upgrade bench with the gun + runes still inside
- Fixed first bosses' AI breaking after a short period of time
- Fixing instances where players could get stuck in a falling loop if standing on top of an enemy while falling

notes.title: Early Access v0.7
notes.notes:
As of 0.7 the other 2 character classes are completed! This brings the pool up to 4 unique classes, each with kits suited to their own playstyle. I am looking to add some polish in-game to make class info a little more accessible, so that players can really get the most out of their choices.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]NEW STUFF[/h2]
==============
[h3]The Gunslinger[/h3]
[i]Abilities[/i]
Called Shot: Mark all enemies in a rectangular area, then summon a phantom revolver to shoot all nearby marked enemies
Double Up: Summon a phantom revolver for 12 seconds that shoots nearby enemies when they take damage
(Passive) Quick Clear: Gain a stacking reload speed buff for each hit. Lose all stacks when missing a shot.

[h3]The Wanderer[/h3]
[i]Abilities[/i]
Shoulder Check: Dash a fixed distance, colliding with any enemy enemies will stop dash and deal AoE damage
Unleash: Gain a large boost to movement speed, melee attack speed, and melee damage. Continually burns mana until empty, at which point the buff deactivates
(Passive) Will To Survive: Gain 5 mana for each enemy hit with a melee attack

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
==================
- Fixed some terrain objects that enemy navigation would get stuck on
- Fixed several cases where networked bullets would phase through terrain
- Moved the character select location in camp to accommodate the increased amount of classes.

notes.title: Early Access v0.6.1
notes.notes:
Today is a minor update that changes up some of the tile layouts as well as adding a new weapon type: staves.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]NEW STUFF[/h2]
======================
[h3]Mana Staff[/h3]
Fires a concentrated beam of mana. Rather than consuming bullets, this weapon consumes mana to fire!
[h3]Tile Updates[/h3]
I wanted to add more verticality and choke points to existing tiles, and have added some obstacles and bridges to the map to reflect this
[h3]AI Changes[/h3]
To accomodate the above, AI have gained the ability to clamber, just like you

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
======================
- Mana Potions drop much more frequently early on, losing drop rate over time

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
======================
- Removed physics sim from most bullet types as it was unneeded. This drastically reduces CPU load in the chaotic late-game.
- Fixed passives sometimes being applied twice on controller

notes.title: Early Access v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Hello! I have been very busy with personal life stuff the last couple of months but I am finally back in the saddle and happy to announce the release of West of the Witchland's first significant new system! Two new NPCs have been added to the main camp each with their own function. With the foundation for camp NPCs set up I am excited to add more dialog and depth to the existing characters as well as add new ones in the near future.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]NEW STUFF[/h2]
============
New NPCS!
[h3]Chef[/h3]
An uncorrupted Gnoll saved from the wastes, players can pick foods off of his rotating menu to obtain per-run stat buffs
[h3]Gunsmith[/h3]
An ex-bounty hunter turned smith, she keeps track of the firearms you've discovered, and with enough use of them can improve their handling for permanent stat buffs

- Added a character stat window to the inventory menu for better tracking of status & buffs
- Improved controller aim assist feel by changing the snapping to a more subtle behavior
- Updated portal visuals - this has been on my to-do list for awhile, the portal is now a proper object in the environment rather than a floating sphere
- Motion Blur Visual Effect - Some new post-processing that I think adds a lot to the game visually. This can be tweaked and/or completely removed in settings

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
==========
- Slightly increased Gatling Gun damage
- Enemy aggro radius decreased

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
============
- An issue with graphics settings resetting when loading a level has been fixed
- Optimized enemy AI performance to be less CPU intensive
- Various UI navigation bugs fixed

notes.title: Early Access v0.5.4
notes.notes:
As we're gearing up for the steam winter sale I'm releasing one more QoL-focused update. This includes plenty of fixes, balance changes, and improvements to character kits.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
==================
- Added the "Judgement" effect to both priest spells. Causing enemies to explode when killed
- Witch's "Flame Wheel" spell is now a toggleable spell that drains energy as it remains active. Spell damage and size have been adjusted as well.
- Witch's "Fireball" spell now explodes when reaching target point
- Introducing the Hyena enemy, a simple melee mob with faster movement speed than the standard gnoll

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
=======================
- Decreased hold time needed to "Equip" items from ground
- Removed revolver from the chest drop pool
- Players now move at regular speed when performing melee attacks

[b]Balance[/b]
- Rebalanced enemy spawn tables to be more lenient at beginning. Will probably adjust one more time in next patch to slow difficulty curve more.
- Enemy movement speed across the board decreased by ~20%
- Reduced enemy Heavies base health by ~35％ [i] - Due to scaling difficulty & rarity on mobs, HP on big mobs could get out of hand[/i]

[b]AI[/b]
- Melee AI is more aggressive
- Enemy AI is optimized to recalculate pathing less when further away from the player
- Added some objects to navmesh detection for better enemy pathing. They are still getting stuck on some corners but overall pathing is much better.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
==========
- Runes stay socketed when upgrading weapons
- Gold and Energy are now affected by magic/rare mob drop quantity modifiers
- Fixed item duplication glitch when transferring a rune from one slot to another on the same weapon
- Fixed some tile boundaries in dungeon generation that would allow them to overlap
- Fixed navigation errors on the weapon & rune upgrade table for controller when upgrade was not affordable

notes.title: Early Access v0.5.3
notes.notes:
A smaller patch this time with just some fixes and quality of life changes. I've been juggling several things recently but soon should be able to refocus on development. My plan is to release one more QoL patch after this before 0.5.5 which should contain some improvements to the magic and melee systems.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
==================
- RARE and MAGIC enemies have been introduced. Both enemy types drop increased gold.
   - Magic enemies have slightly increased health & damage and appear with a blue glow
   - Rare enemies have greatly increased health & damage and appear with a yellow glow
- Guns now have a limited supply of ammo, ammo is tracked on a per-weapon basis and starts at the maximum amount
- Enemies now have a chance to drop ammo on death, picking one of these up refills a portion of maximum ammo for both equipped guns
- Enemy ragdolls are now permanent by default. A slider has been added to add a despawn time if desired
- Added some icon indicators for equipped runes in the bottom right weapon display

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
================
- Enemy base health has across the board been reduced to balance out the addition of Magic & Rare modifiers + ammo limitations.
- The melee attack animation is now instantly cancelleable into any other action
- Fixed behavior of an "X" button in the character select menu to close out just the menu rather than the game.
- Adjusted socket points of a few tiles to fix height differences breaking navigation and enemy AI

notes.title: Early Access v0.5.2
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone who has checked out the game so far! Have gotten lots of good feedback already and have been able to get some fixes in this week along with a few new bits of content.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
=======================
- Added the gnoll chanter, a melee/caster hybrid that regularly shouts to buff nearby enemies with a speed boost. They can be spotted by their purple caster robes.
- Have added 4 new tile shapes, I wanted to start experimenting with more complex and vertical tiles, if this does not create problems with dungeon generation will probably add more tiles of this sort in future patches
- Added a slider to allow adjusting screenshake. This go down to 0% to completely disable it or 200% to double it for funsies. (Thank you for the suggestion!)

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
=======================
- Increased shadow visibility in later phases of the day
- Gold and Energy drops are now picked up when moving close rather than automatically vacuuming to player
	- Have found that seeing all the gold on the field after a big fight and running around to pick it up rather than it immediately vacuuming to the player is much more satisfying
	
[h2]Balance Tweaks[/h2]
=======================
- Gatling gun - DPS got out of hand with runes + reduce stress on network
	- Clip size reduced from 120 => 80
	- Time between bullets increased from 0.05s => 0.1s
	- Damage per bullet increased from 10 => 15

- Trench gun
	- Increasing bullet count from 4 => 5
	- Decreasing scatter width from 8 => 6
	- Damage per bullet reduced from 40 => 35

- Flamethrower
	- Clip Size 30 => 50

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
=======================
- Fixed an issue where some settings would reset when launching the game
- Fixed an issue when refreshing a shop after selling items produced infinite gold
- Fixed a missing reference that prevented gibbing
- Fixed Status FX not updating/expiring on other clients in multiplayer

notes.title: Early Access Release v0.5.1
notes.notes:
We made it to Early Access! Here are some stuff added & fixed for day 1

Content
===========
[u]Weapons[/u]
[list]
[*]Assault Rifle - A rapid fire two-handed rifle
[*]Trench Gun - A close quarters pump action shotgun.
[/list]

[u]Runes[/u]
[list]
[*]Tracer - Shots mark enemies, causing them to take increased damage
[*]Primed - The first bullet after reloading deals increased damage
[*]Cursed - Bullets deal more damage but damage the player on firing
[*]Sharpening - Bullet kills gain a stacking crit chance buff for each recent kill
[/list]

[u]Passives[/u]
[list]
[*]Formidable - Shields you create have increased durability
[*]Sanctuary - Shares a small portion of shield created with nearby players
[*]Thorns - Release a damaging shockwave when hit that scales with current shield
[*]Overflow - Excess energy is converted to shield
[*]Proliferate - DoTs applied by you spread to other enemies on death
[/list]
Misc
=========
[list]
[*] Added explicit descriptions for each difficulty setting
[*] Updated vfx for some weapon mods & status conditions
[*] Fixing main hub song not looping properly
[*] Fixing some controller navigation in menus
[*] Fixed some rune scaling values not highlighting correctly in the description
[/list]
